summary: Meta released version 0.4.0 of the SONAR library, upgrading its Fairseq2 dependency, adding support for reduced torch precision and length-based batching in the text encoder.

practices.reason: Reduced torch precision support offers a reproducible speedup technique but no quantified gain is given, so it should be evaluated before adoption.
practices.quote: Support decreased torch precision (for speedup purposes)

practices.reason: The new minimum Fairseq2 version requirement is a concrete dependency change that must be scheduled for any team using SONAR.
practices.quote: Upgrade to a stable version of [Fairseq2](https://github.com/facebookresearch/fairseq2/):  `fairseq2>=0.4.0`
